entities.name: Michał Piwnicki
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Michał Jan Piwnicki was a Roman Catholic bishop of the Diocese of Lutsk-Zytomierz from 1828 to his death in 1845. He previously served as coadjutor bishop of the same Diocese and titular bishop of Rama from 1827 to 1828.
